# Attestix

> Agent identity, signed credentials, delegated authority and portable governance evidence. Apache 2.0. Signatures do not establish legal conformity, trusted issuer authority, live revocation or complete capture.

Every docs page below is also available as raw markdown at its URL plus `.md`. This file is generated at build time from the docs themselves.

## Site

- [Home](https://attestix.io/): What Attestix is, how it works, install in three commands
- [Research](https://attestix.io/research): Product vision, the research paper, and technical notes
- [Platform](https://attestix.io/platform): Agent identity, signed records, verification boundaries and integrations
- [Console demo](https://attestix.io/console): Interactive preview of the Attestix workspace; data is simulated
- [Verify a credential](https://attestix.io/verify): In-browser W3C VC verifier; nothing uploaded
- [Bundle wire format v1](https://attestix.io/spec/bundle/v1): Frozen spec of the portability bundle format
- [EU AI Act fine calculator](https://attestix.io/demo/fine-calculator): Illustrative Article 99 estimator; assess actual applicability separately
- [Pricing](https://attestix.io/pricing): Self-hosted source and proposed hosted-service availability
- [Changelog](https://attestix.io/changelog): Release history
- [Security](https://attestix.io/security): Responsible disclosure

## Docs

- [Attestix](https://attestix.io/docs.md): Attestation Infrastructure for AI Agents - the compliance identity layer for the EU AI Act era.
- [Getting Started with Attestix](https://attestix.io/docs/getting-started.md): Get your first AI agent identity in under 5 minutes.
- [Offline credential verifiers](https://attestix.io/docs/verifiers.md): Language-specific verification helpers and their trust boundaries.
- [Quickstart: pick your role](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart.md): Copy-paste to verifiable agents in 90 seconds. One page per ICP persona from the v0.4.0 funnel evaluation, written against the actual pain point that persona hit.
- [Indie AI-agent dev Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/indie-dev.md): For the solo founder shipping a LangChain RAG agent fast. Skip the boilerplate, get a hash-chained audit trail and a signed VC on every chain completion.
- [Fintech compliance engineer Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/fintech-compliance.md): Wire a trading or credit-scoring agent with hash-chained audit, signed inference logs, and a third-party conformity assessment record, without a database.
- [Healthcare ML lead: Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/healthcare-ml.md): Record training-data provenance, model lineage, and an Annex III high-risk profile for a clinical decision-support agent. local data erasure tooling included; DPDP / HIPAA-adjacent obligations called out honestly.
- [Enterprise platform architect Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/enterprise-architect.md): Run Attestix as a service behind your own ingress. Multi-tenant context, idempotent REST, hash-chained audit. Honest about what's not in v0.4.0.
- [EU AI Act / GRC consultant Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/grc-consultant.md): Generate Annex IV technical documentation and an Annex V Declaration of Conformity for a client's high-risk AI system. Honest about where cryptographic integrity ends and human / notified-body sign-off begins.
- [DevTools / DX skeptic Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/devtools-skeptic.md): Does the package actually import? Yes, in v0.4.0-rc.5. Here's the smallest possible test you can run in 60 seconds to verify the DX claim before reading anything else.
- [Web3 / on-chain dev Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/web3-onchain.md): Anchor an Attestix artefact to Base L2 Sepolia testnet via the Ethereum Attestation Service. Schema UID, gas estimate, faucet, on-chain verification (testnet only in v0.4.0).
- [AI safety researcher Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/ai-safety-research.md): Produce signed, hash-chained telemetry from an LLM-agent eval run that other labs can re-verify offline. No backend, no cloud.
- [Startup CTO Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/startup-cto.md): 5-minute build-vs-buy proof of what Attestix gives you that you would otherwise build yourself for agent identity, audit, and EU AI Act paperwork.
- [MLOps engineer Quickstart](https://attestix.io/docs/quickstart/mlops-engineer.md): Wire Attestix into a CI/CD pipeline so every model promotion produces a signed credential and a hash-chained audit row. Pinned versions, deterministic CLI, exit codes.
- [Examples](https://attestix.io/docs/examples.md): Runnable examples for every Attestix module, from identity creation to full EU AI Act compliance workflows.
- [EU AI Act Compliance with Attestix](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/eu-ai-act-compliance.md): Step-by-step guide to recording AI governance evidence. Workflow completion is not a legal conformity determination.
- [EU Compliance Walkthrough](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/eu-compliance-walkthrough.md): This guide has been renamed. See the EU AI Act Compliance guide for the full walkthrough.
- [EU AI Act Risk Classification Guide](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/risk-classification.md): How to determine the risk category for your AI system under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689).
- [Reputation Scoring Guide](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/reputation.md): Build trust between AI agents using Attestix's recency-weighted reputation system with interaction tracking, category breakdowns, and threshold-based queries.
- [Integration Guide](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/integration-guide.md): How to use Attestix with LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, plain Python, and other MCP clients.
- [LangChain Integration](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/langchain.md): Drop Attestix into a LangChain agent with the BaseCallbackHandler. Real (not example) integration shipped in v0.3.0; v0.4.0-rc.2 release candidate. Every tool call, LLM call, and chain step gets hash-chained and signed.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK Integration](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/openai-agents-sdk.md): Expose MCP tools natively to the OpenAI Agents SDK via MCPServerStdio. Real (not example) integration shipped in v0.3.0; v0.4.0-rc.2 release candidate.
- [CrewAI Integration](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/crewai.md): Attach Attestix to every CrewAI agent via MCPServerAdapter. Real (not example) integration shipped in v0.3.0; v0.4.0-rc.2 release candidate. Crews become attestable by default.
- [Offline Verification Walkthrough](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/offline-verify.md): How a regulator, auditor, or other agent verifies an Attestix Verifiable Credential without any network access.
- [Base L2 Testnet Anchor Walkthrough](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/base-l2-anchor.md): Anchor an Attestix artefact hash to Base L2 testnet via the Ethereum Attestation Service. End-to-end guide with Sepolia faucets, gas estimates, and verification.
- [Migrating to the canonical attestix.* namespace (v0.4.0-rc.2)](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/migration-v0.4.0-namespace.md): Move existing Attestix integrations from the legacy flat top-level packages (services/, auth/, ...) to the canonical attestix.* namespace before the deprecation shims are removed in v0.5.0.
- [npm package rename: @vibetensor/attestix to attestix](https://attestix.io/docs/guides/migration-npm-rename.md): How to migrate to the bare 'attestix' name on npm (now matching pip install attestix on PyPI).
